costs.tax_note: Prices exclude applicable taxes. Hetzner prices are for Germany (FSN/NBG), include one $0.60/month Cloud Primary IPv4, and exclude backups, snapshots, additional storage, and traffic overages.
costs.notes: The CPX22, CPX42, and CCX33 rows reproduce the benchmark host profiles and are listed for each self-hosted renderer so their direct infrastructure costs can be compared. A target concurrency is a benchmark scenario label, not a claim that the server guarantees that capacity; use the measured latency, throughput, resource, and failure results. Cloudflare is modeled as Browser Run Quick Actions on Workers Paid, so Browser Sessions concurrency charges do not apply. Prices were verified from official vendor pages on 2026-08-15.

dompdf-existing-capacity.label: DOMPDF on existing Laravel capacity
dompdf-existing-capacity.price_notes: The $0 direct infrastructure cost applies only when the existing application server has sufficient spare CPU and memory. Rendering still competes with application traffic.

browsershot-existing-capacity.label: Browsershot on existing Laravel capacity
browsershot-existing-capacity.price_notes: The $0 direct infrastructure cost applies only when sufficient spare capacity and all Node.js, Chromium, and system dependencies already exist. Rendering competes with application traffic.

gotenberg-existing-capacity.label: Gotenberg on existing container capacity
gotenberg-existing-capacity.price_notes: The $0 direct infrastructure cost applies only when an existing Docker host has sufficient spare capacity. The customer still operates and monitors the Gotenberg service.
